description_en: Uploads house data generated by mobile-side algorithm processing to the cloud, where the cloud algorithm module performs 3D model reconstruction
description_zh: 通过移动端算法处理会生成相应的房屋数据，将该数据上传至云端后，可通过云端算法模块进行三维模型重建
name: AddRoomPlan

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The error details for access denied errors

AuthAction.description_en: The operation information used for authentication in the request
AuthAction.description_zh: 请求中用于鉴权的操作信息

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en:
The identity used for authentication in the request. Valid values:
RAM user: the UID of the RAM user.
RAM role: RoleName:RoleSessionName.
Federated: ProviderType/ProviderName
AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_zh:
请求中用于鉴权的身份标识。具体取值为：
RAM 用户：RAM 用户 UID
RAM 角色：RoleName:RoleSessionName
Federated：ProviderType/ProviderName

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the identity used for authentication in the request belongs
AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_zh: 请求中用于鉴权的身份所属的阿里云账号UID信息

AuthPrincipalType.description_en:
The type of the identity used for authentication in the request. Valid values:
SubUser: RAM user.
AssumedRoleUser: RAM role.
Federated: SSO federated identity
AuthPrincipalType.description_zh:
请求中用于鉴权的身份类型。具体取值为：
RAM 用户：SubUser
RAM 角色：AssumedRoleUser
SSO 联合身份：Federated

EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_en: The encoded diagnostic information for permission diagnostics
EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_zh: 编码后的用于权限诊断的信息

NoPermissionType.description_en:
The reason that caused the authentication failure. Valid values:
ExplicitDeny: explicit deny.
ImplicitDeny: implicit deny
NoPermissionType.description_zh:
NoPermissionType导致鉴权失败的原因。具体取值为：
ExplicitDeny：显示拒绝
ImplicitDeny：隐式拒绝

PolicyType.description_en:
The type of the policy that caused the authentication failure. Valid values:
ControlPolicy: control policy.
SessionPolicy: session policy.
AssumeRolePolicy: role trust policy.
AccountLevelIdentityBasedPolicy: identity-based policy at the account level.
ResourceGroupLevelIdentityBasedPolicy: identity-based policy at the resource group level.
BucketPolicy: OSS bucket policy.
ProjectPolicy: SLS project policy
PolicyType.description_zh:
导致鉴权失败的策略类型。具体取值为：
管控策略：ControlPolicy
会话策略：SessionPolicy
角色信任策略：AssumeRolePolicy
基于身份策略（账号级）：AccountLevelIdentityBasedPolicy
基于身份策略（资源组级）： ResourceGroupLevelIdentityBasedPolicy
OSS Bucket Policy：BucketPolicy
SLS Project Policy：ProjectPolicy

AccessId.description_en: The access ID. This is used as the OSSAccessKeyId parameter when uploading with the OSS SDK

Callback.description_en: The upload callback. This is a reserved field and is not currently used
Callback.description_zh: 上传回调，保留字段，目前未使用

Dir.description_en: The authorized path. This is used as a parameter when uploading with the OSS SDK. Append the file name to this path before use. For example, ${DIR}/xxx.jpg corresponds to the key parameter
Dir.description_zh: 授权路径，OSS SDK上传时参数，需要拼接文件名后使用， ${DIR}/xxx.jpg对应key

Expire.description_en: The authorization expiration time, in seconds. Use this value to check whether the authorization is still valid. After expiration, the authorization becomes unavailable
Expire.description_zh: 授权失效时间(s)，可以判断授权是否在有效期内，失效后授权不可用

Host.description_en: The upload address. This is the request URL when uploading with the OSS SDK
Host.description_zh: 上传地址, OSS SDK上传时的请求地址

Policy.description_en: The authorization policy. This is used as the policy parameter when uploading with the OSS SDK
Policy.description_zh: 授权，OSS SDK上传时参数，对应policy

Signature.description_en: The signature. This is used as the signature parameter when uploading with the OSS SDK
Signature.description_zh: 签名，OSS SDK上传时参数，对应signature

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which corresponds to the requestId input parameter

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
